mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:slide permutations execute21 saved outcomes and atomic refusals
outcomes: The unit wrapper executes all 21 canonical rows and asserts an empty failure list and exactly 21 passed cases.
The pinned acceptance bindings assert reopened title/notes order and receipts, exact unrelated payloads, unchanged XML outside list entries, stable handles, and refusal bytes/order.
gaps: Wrapper assertions aggregate step outcomes; the concrete outcome assertions live in the separately pinned helper.
No native leaf-count inference beyond the explicit 21-case acceptance result; broader deck metadata is unsupported.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:reorder preserves captured slide anchors and table cells while indexes follow order
outcomes: Reordering keeps the slide version and retained cell value while indexes follow the new order.
A content edit invalidates an old anchor; reopened original slide contains Changed, after and same slide.
gaps: The canonical scenario names stable identities but lacks rows for table-cell and content-version transitions.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:a text anchor captured before reorder can still edit its original slide
outcomes: A pre-reorder text anchor edits its original slide; reopened titles are Beta, Gamma, Updated.
gaps: The rotate row checks saved order but has no explicit pre-reorder-anchor action.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:slide arrays are detached and repeated reorder plus append maintain indexes
outcomes: Mutating a returned slide array does not alter owned count or handles.
Repeated reorder and append retain indexes and reopen as Delta, Alpha, Beta, Gamma.
gaps: Detached-array and append-after-reorder sequences lack canonical rows.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:serialization rollback preserves earlier edits, handle identities and order snapshot
outcomes: Injected serialization failure preserves bytes, handle order and the first slide index.
A later valid reorder succeeds with the earlier edit retained.
gaps: The canonical refusal scenario has no injected serializer-failure row.
This test inspects the retained edit in memory after retry; disk rollback is not asserted here.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:UTF16 LE/BE presentation metadata preserves BOM and all other payloads
outcomes: Both byte orders reopen with the original BOM/encoding declaration, Gamma first and all other parts byte-identical.
gaps: Canonical rows lack UTF-16 variants.
The body loop and all-members preservation loop are retained for expansion review; no measured runtime leaf count.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:slide entries retain exact quote spelling, local aliases and whitespace slots
outcomes: Raw slide-ID entries retain quote spelling and local relationship-prefix declarations in reordered slots.
The list content equals the expected entries separated by the original whitespace slots.
gaps: Canonical alias rows do not enumerate local per-entry aliases or exact quote/slot whitespace variants.
Assertions inspect package XML in memory; no saved reopen in this declaration.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:permutations reject sparse/getter/nonarray/extended data without invoking getters
outcomes: Invalid arrays and nonarrays throw and preserve exact archive bytes; accessors are never invoked.
gaps: Canonical rows cover ordinary numeric permutation errors, not sparse/accessor/nonarray/symbol-property variants.
Dynamic loop expansion is reviewed as source only; no measured runtime leaf count.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:same-order requests still validate protection, IDs and stale metadata
outcomes: No-op requests reject unsafe metadata and preserve archive bytes.
A raw root relationship edit rejects both reorder and append before further mutation.
gaps: No-op refusal and root-relationship/append interactions lack dedicated canonical rows.
Loop variants are not expanded into measured leaves.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:invalid lexical slide IDs refuse before archive changes
outcomes: Out-of-range, malformed and negative lexical slide IDs refuse with exact archive bytes retained.
gaps: The canonical duplicate-ID row does not specify these four lexical/range variants.
Loop variants are not expanded into measured leaves.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:disk saved slide order and linked notes follow logical handles
outcomes: After disk save/reopen the rotated titles are Beta, Gamma, Alpha and notes are Notes 1, Notes 2, Notes 0.
gaps: The canonical notes row uses reversal; this native test combines notes with rotation.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:noncanonical numeric own keys and accessors refuse instead of hiding extra order data
outcomes: Extra 00/01/0002 own keys throw without changing archive bytes, for data and accessor properties; no getter runs.
gaps: The canonical refusal scenario lacks noncanonical own-key data/accessor rows.
Nested loops are retained for expansion review; no measured runtime leaf count.

mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-slide-order.test.ts:public three-argument Slide constructor retains identity across reorders
outcomes: A public constructor alias follows the original part from index 0 to 2 and reopens with Alias and retained text.

gaps: Canonical identity rows do not exercise public constructor aliases or missing-part aliases.
